fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The top-level error code, or `0` if there was no top-level error.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The top-level error message, or `null` if there was no top-level error.

fields.name: Feature
fields.about: The name of the finalized feature.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The feature update error code or `0` if the feature update succeeded.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The feature update error, or `null` if the feature update succeeded.
